svg.text: L_SM — the paths from every point of the brim, every direction: what reaches the tip

Standard-Model Higgs hat (brim radius 1). Kept only the paths that pass within 0.15 of the hilltop (selected by outcome, not aimed). Height = the hat's own units: brim 0, hilltop 1; a path rises by W/(V0 τ0).
the brim ring: every source point on it
paths of the lowest sheet of the action: W = 0.4310 at the tip (closed form 0.4310)
the second sheet: out to the wall at r = √2 and back, W = 0.9025 = 0.4310 + 2 × 0.2357
the tip: 0.2189 above the hilltop (units of the depth); tip is 0.0015 R from the hilltop; paths: 698 of 34584 launched
